# Phicon Widgets fixtures

Reference exports from the TEI'27 sketch `PaperPhicons_Boilerplate_v1_1_Cutout` (local folder
`TEI27Software`, not a git repo; `params.json` records a SHA-256 of the sketch's `.pde` files
instead of a commit). Each `<case>/` has the sketch's three files under fixed names (`print.pdf`,
`fold.svg`, `calib.svg`; the sketch names them `result_`, `res_f_`, `calib_f_` plus a timestamp)
and `params.json`.

Generated by `node scripts/fixtures/phiconwidgets/generate.mjs` from
`scripts/fixtures/phiconwidgets/cases.json`. Do not edit by hand. The sketch always exports the
cut-out being edited as well as the added ones; the harness makes the last cut-out of each case
the one being edited.
